card.name: Word just before a drug name repeats
card.fires_on: Words or word parts in drug-label text right before the text names or repeats a specific drug, such as 'per million azithromycin' or 'mg/mL of imetelstat'.

modes.label: Before a drug name
modes.description: Linking word or number unit right ahead of a drug name that was already mentioned.

modes.label: Inside or ending a drug name
modes.description: Fires on the last part of a drug name or on a label code letter.

modes.description: The word 'as' in 'whether used as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy'.
